documents.title: Standard for Acceptable Use of Artificial Intelligence with University Data
documents.quality_note: Official university standard for all users (faculty, staff, students) on acceptable and ethical AI use; focused on university data and approved tools, not on classroom rules.

documents.unit: JMU Libraries (with Center for Faculty Innovation)
documents.title: Academic Integrity, Syllabi Statements and AI (Artificial Intelligence in Education guide)
documents.quality_note: Library research-guide advice to instructors on principles, syllabus statements and assignment-level expectations; not an official policy, and fuller guidance lives on a Canvas site that is not public. Kept because it is the only classroom-facing JMU guidance found.

notes: No JMU provost or Honor Code AI policy page was found in search; a 2023 Breeze article and search summaries say the provost delegated AI rules to professors, but that is news and was not collected. lib.jmu.edu/ai/faculty/ fetched and is a resource directory (generic), not collected. Computing: the only known computing items are course syllabi (CS 149, CS 240, CS 470 and others), which are deferred; no Department of Computer Science AI policy page found. Course syllabi deferred.
